# Setup

## Libraries

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: true

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Data

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: true

datapisum_6 <- read.csv( "../../../../02.analyses/01.GWAS/01_phenotipic_analysis/02.ajusted_means/pisum/emmeans_pisum_6.csv")

datafabae_4 <- read.csv("../../../../02.analyses/01.GWAS/01_phenotipic_analysis/02.ajusted_means/fabae/emmeans_fabae_4.csv")

pisum <- datapisum_6 %>%
  dplyr::select(ivip, emmean) %>%
  dplyr::rename(larvae_pisum = emmean)

fabae <- datafabae_4 %>%
  dplyr::select(ivip, emmean) %>%
  dplyr::rename(larvae_fabae = emmean)

merged <- inner_join(pisum, fabae, by = "ivip")
```

::: callout-note
The merged dataset contains `r nrow(merged)` IVIPs that were phenotyped for both A. pisum and A. fabae, and for which we have adjusted mean fecundity scores for both aphid species.
:::

# Correlation analysis

## Correlation test

```{r}
cor_test <- cor.test(merged$larvae_pisum, merged$larvae_fabae)
```

::: callout-note
Correlation between A. pisum and A. fabae fecundity scores for shared IVIPs is weak.\
- R correlation score is equal to `r round(cor_test$estimate, 3)`.\
- The corresponding p-value is equal to `r round(cor_test$p.value, 3)` (not significant).
:::

# The script used for fecundity figure (Figure 1)

```{r}

cor_test <- cor.test(merged$larvae_pisum, merged$larvae_fabae)
cor_test
png("corplot_fabae_pisum.png", width = 800, height = 600)

ggplot(merged, aes(x = larvae_pisum, y = larvae_fabae)) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf, y = Inf,
    label = " " ,
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5,
    size = 4  # Adjust size of the annotated text
  ) +
  labs(
    title = " ",
    x = expression("Adjusted mean of aphid count" ~ italic("(A. pisum)")),
    y = expression("Adjusted mean of aphid count" ~ italic("(A. fabae)"))
  ) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10),  # Title size
    axis.title = element_text(size = 23),  # Axis label size
    axis.text = element_text(size = 15)    # Axis tick label size
  )
dev.off()


fabae<-read.csv("../../../01.GWAS/01_phenotipic_analysis/02.ajusted_means/fabae/emmeans_fabae_4.csv", sep = ",")
pisum <- read.csv("../../../01.GWAS/01_phenotipic_analysis/02.ajusted_means/pisum/emmeans_pisum_6.csv", sep = ",")

png("emmean_histogram_Afabae.png", width = 800, height = 500)

ggplot(fabae, aes(x = emmean)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30,
    color = "black",
    fill = "grey70"
  ) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  labs(
    title = "Histogram of emmean (A. fabae)",
    x = "emmean",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16),  # Title size
    axis.title = element_text(size = 34),  # Axis label size
    axis.text = element_text(size = 22)    # Axis tick label size
  )

dev.off()


png("emmean_histogram_Apisum.png", width = 800, height = 500)

ggplot(pisum, aes(x = emmean)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30,
    color = "black",
    fill = "grey70"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Histogram of emmean (A. pisum)",  # Fixed title for A. pisum
    x = "emmean",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16),  # Title size
    axis.title = element_text(size = 34),  # Axis label size
    axis.text = element_text(size = 22)    # Axis tick label size
  )

dev.off()

```
